events.description: 10. ORDER denying without prejudice 2 Motion to Seal. To seal information from the public record, the Court must find that there are clear and compelling reasons for the requested sealing, and that the request for sealing is narrowly tailored. See Local Rule 5(e). Although Plaintiff asserts that the sealing of his name, address, email and phone number is necessary for "safety" reasons and raises concerns regarding "online exposure," Plaintiff does not sufficiently articulate the reasons for the alleged risk of safety. The motion is therefore denied without prejudice to renewal. The Clerk is directed to unseal this case. Signed by Judge Sarala V. Nagala on August 13, 2025. (Bergeson, S) (Entered: 08/13/2025)

events.description: 11. ORDER denying 4 Motion for Leave to Proceed In Forma Pauperis. Plaintiff has filed a motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis. But this motion is filed on a form that fails to comport with the requirements for the District of Connecticut. Therefore, this motion is denied without prejudice to resubmission.Plaintiff may access the correct form here: https://www.ctd.uscourts.gov/forms/motion-leave-proceed-forma-pauperis. Plaintiff shall file any renewed motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis, or pay the filing fee, by August 27, 2025, or this case will be dismissed. Signed by Judge Sarala V. Nagala on August 13, 2025. (Bergeson, S) (Entered: 08/13/2025)
